test_cases.tc_title: Subscription status: Shall be reported as "Not Subscribed", "Subscribed", "Suspend Alert", or "Suspended". (read $2844, Subscription status = "Subscribed")
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. The Sirius XM chipset is powered and responding
4. The Sirius XM subscription is in the "Subscribed" state
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Read the Sirius XM subscription data
   $ 22 28 44
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The positive response 62 28 44 <Sirius XM subscription data record> is received, and the record reports the Subscription status as "Subscribed"
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.split_reason: R-DIAG25(a)：錨列舉之每一狀態各成一條 sibling；態之建立方式 CFTS004 未載，依 §8.5 例外只寫態、不寫建立步驟。取代 CDD-07 之單條收斂（該次依下放包升級條件「錨不足四個」處置，R-DIAG25(a) 出後前提不再成立）
test_cases.remarks: Placeholder values resolved at execution by the diagnostic tool loaded with the ECU CDD file

test_cases.tc_title: The DiagService shall interpret the received 0x31 (RoutineControl) request for DID 0xD013 and extract the tone routing / speaker output selection parameter. ($5000, externally generated tone on all four quadrants)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. Security access 0x27 has been granted
4. An input signal is applied to the AV1 analog audio input (aux)
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Activate a tool-controlled tone without requesting specific speaker outputs
   $ 2F 50 00 03 <controlState for "tool-controlled tone">
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The positive response 6F 50 00 is received, and the externally generated tone is played on each of the four quadrants, and the speaker quadrant selection has no effect on it
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.split_reason: R-DIAG23(c)：CFTS004-4940293（Information）補充本列已引之 4940296 —— externally generated tone 之輸入端為 AV1 aux，且不受 speaker quadrant selection 影響、四象限皆播。該 Information 列之 `SYS-RA-DIAG-328` 未被 037 引用，但其所補充者為 037 已引之 FR，依 R-DIAG23(c) 列為候選並產出
test_cases.remarks: Placeholder values resolved at execution by the diagnostic tool loaded with the ECU CDD file
pc_sources: PC-1: SYSAD §4.5 Session & Security Assumptions（ECU starts in Default Session）
PC-2: SYSAD §4.5 Hardware Dependencies（Diagnostic connector (OBD-II)）
PC-3: SYSAD §4.5（保守套用；列舉未含 I/O Control）
PC-4: CFTS004-4940296（…unless specific outputs are requested…）

test_cases.tc_title: The DiagService shall interpret the received 0x31 (RoutineControl) request for DID 0x0312 and extract the channel input selection parameter. ($0312, detection on each individual signal line)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. Security access 0x27 has been granted
4. An audio test tone of 1 kHz at 0 dB is applied to <each individual signal line of the channel input under test>
5. The video test pattern "Screen 3: 10 step" is applied to the channel input under test
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Start the AV signal detection routine on the channel input under test
   $ 31 01 03 12 <AV Channel Number>
2. Request the results of the AV signal detection routine
   $ 31 03 03 12
test_cases.expected_result:
1. The positive response 71 01 03 12 is received
2. The positive response 71 03 03 12 <routine results> is received, and the results report the detection outcome for each individual signal line of the channel input under test
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.split_reason: R-DIAG23(c)：CFTS004-4940480 補充本列已引之 4940473 —— 使用多條訊號線之輸入須逐線提供偵測。哪些輸入使用多條訊號線 CFTS004 未載，故以 `<…>` 佔位（feasible = P，token DR-DIAG-5）
test_cases.remarks: Harman Scope: Need Rework; SID per 037 SWE1-Diagnostics-151; Placeholder values resolved at execution by the diagnostic tool loaded with the ECU CDD file
pc_sources: PC-1: SYSAD §4.5 Session & Security Assumptions（ECU starts in Default Session）
PC-2: SYSAD §4.5 Hardware Dependencies（Diagnostic connector (OBD-II)）
PC-3: SYSAD §4.5 Session & Security Assumptions（Security access (0x27) is required for: Write DID / Routine execution / DTC clearing）
PC-4: CFTS004-4940477（The expected audio test tones shall be 1 kHz and 0 dB）
PC-5: CFTS004-4940478（The expected video test pattern shall be the "Screen 3: 10 step" screen）

test_cases.tc_title: The radio shall tune to a specific frequency when receiving a command from this DID. ($5009, tuned frequency equals F + S*N)
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. The ECU is in the default diagnostic session
2. The diagnostic tool is connected to the OBD-II diagnostic connector
3. Security access 0x27 has been granted
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Send the command to update the tuned frequency
   $ 2F 50 09 03 <controlState for "tuned frequency">
2. Read the tuned frequency
   $ 22 50 09
test_cases.expected_result:
1. The positive response 6F 50 09 is received, and the radio tunes to <starting frequency of the current band> + <frequency step size of the current band> * <step number sent in the command>
2. The positive response 62 50 09 <tuned frequency byte> is received, and the reported value is the frequency calculated in step 1
test_cases.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
test_cases.split_reason: R-DIAG23(c)：CFTS004-4940338 補充本列已引之 4940337 —— new tuned frequency = F + S*N。F（band 起始頻率）與 S（band 頻率級距）CFTS004 未載其值，故以 `<…>` 佔位（feasible = P，token DR-DIAG-5）
test_cases.remarks: Placeholder values resolved at execution by the diagnostic tool loaded with the ECU CDD file
pc_sources: PC-1: SYSAD §4.5 Session & Security Assumptions（ECU starts in Default Session）
PC-2: SYSAD §4.5 Hardware Dependencies（Diagnostic connector (OBD-II)）
PC-3: SYSAD §4.5（保守套用；列舉未含 I/O Control）
